IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Herrera, Wallace, Orcutt, and Moeller

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to naming state highway routes; and amending RCW47.17.645 and 47.17.650.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.645 and 1970 ex.s. c 51 s 130 are each amendedto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 502, anddesignated as the Battle Ground highway, is established as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number 5 in the vicinitynorth of Vancouver, thence easterly to a junction with state routenumber 503 at Battle Ground.

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.17.650 and 1991 c 342 s 35 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A state highway to be known as state route number 503 isestablished as follows: Beginning at a junction with state route number 500 at Orchards,thence northerly to a junction with state route number 502 at BattleGround, thence northerly to Amboy, thence northeasterly by way ofCougar to the CowlitzSkamania county line; also p. 1 HB 1094 Beginning at a junction with state route number 503 in the vicinityof Yale, thence westerly to a junction with state route number 5 in thevicinity of Woodland. That portion of state route number 503 from the junction with stateroute number 500 at Orchards, thence northerly to a junction with stateroute number 502 at Battle Ground, thence northerly to Amboy isdesignated as the Lewisville highway.
